tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows are confined to short horizons despite a target H=21.5; the slow adaptation component and reversal remain unidentified. The specified slow-horizon discriminating probe is the relevant next measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation law from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations only span H=0.16–0.48 and cannot identify the slow decay/reversal at forecast horizon 21.5.
More fine short-horizon data would not resolve the slow-timescale ambiguity.
It does not distinguish the candidate temporal mechanisms and is explicitly unnecessary.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a snapshot Ricker or periodic model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot signatures and supplied verified mechanism support horizon-conditioned adaptation, while short-horizon-only samples cannot reliably distinguish it from alternatives.
